server.instructions: agencecinq.com, the site of the CINQ web agency: pages, blog posts and case studies. Write all copy in French, addressing the reader as « vous ». No emoji, no em dash. Create and update content as drafts unless asked to publish. Before writing to a page, a post or a case study, read its lock_content field: when it is true, do not write nor change its content, and never change lock_content unless asked. Never invent a client, a figure, a quote or a finding: client names, logos, screenshots and verbatims appear only with the written consent of the client. Write real alternative text in the media library: the theme follows RGAA. Follow the page template that fits the page, and say so when a section has no block rather than approximating it. The front page and case studies open with their own hero fields, not with blocks. Blog posts have no blocks: their body is the post content. The primary call to action is « Réserver 30 minutes »: the diagnostic is never a first click.

accordion.description: Questions and answers: the section heading on the left, the questions on the right, the first one open.

action_cards.description: One card per situation of a visitor, with the offer that answers it and its price, read from the CINQ Central catalogue.
action_cards.guidance: Do not write prices: they come from Central.

activity_log.description: The latest repositories of the agency and their commits over six months, read from GitHub.
activity_log.guidance: Name a private repository only with the written consent of its client.

breadcrumb.description: Breadcrumb of the page, from Yoast SEO.
breadcrumb.guidance: First block of a page below a silo (service, local, emergency or offer page), right above the Page header. Not on top-level pages, nor on case studies, which render their own.

bullet_list.description: Short list of rules or principles, one per row, on the elevated background.

checklist.description: Numbered points to check, each with the question to ask, then a call to action.

comparison.description: Before and after of a redesigned site in a window splitter, with the findings written with the client.
comparison.guidance: Mostly on case studies. Findings come from the client interview: nothing invented.

contact_details.description: The ways to reach the agency: the 30-minute call first, then the phone and the email, read from the theme options.
contact_details.guidance: No form: the conversions are the clicks on the call, the phone and the email.

cta.description: Centred closing call to action: title, text, primary button and what the click leads to.
cta.guidance: Usually the last block. Write its title and text for the page: the same call everywhere reads as if the page had not changed.

diff_columns.description: Two columns side by side: the lines that go today, then the lines that come in after the redesign.

feature_cards.description: One card per deliverable handed over to the client: the file name in monospace, then what it is.

image_cards.description: Case study cards: screenshot, client, situation and summary, taken from the case studies themselves.
image_cards.guidance: Pick existing case studies, or leave the selection empty for the three latest. Do not create case studies from page copy.

link_columns.description: The sitemap, built from the Sitemap Menu.
link_columns.guidance: Only on the sitemap page. Edit the Sitemap Menu, not the block, to change its links.

link_grid.description: Hub of a silo: one card per child page.
link_grid.guidance: On a parent page, after its Page header.

link_row.description: Up to four links to sibling pages at the end of a page.
link_row.guidance: Near the end of a page, before the CTA.

listing_header.description: Header of the blog: title in H1, text, then the categories as filters.
listing_header.guidance: Only on the page for posts, first block.

logo_wall.description: Wall of client logos, all the same size.
logo_wall.guidance: Only clients who gave their written consent.

numbered_list.description: Ordered list of items, numbered from 01, on the elevated background.

page_header.description: Top of a situation, an offer or a silo page: title in H1, text, buttons and an optional before and after.
page_header.guidance: Once per page, first or right after the Breadcrumb. Not on the front page nor on case studies, which open with their hero fields.

portrait_grid.description: The team: square black and white portraits with first names, over a scrolling CINQ band.

post_grid.description: The posts of the blog as article cards, with pagination.
post_grid.guidance: Only on the page for posts, after the Listing header: elsewhere it shows nothing.

price_breakdown.description: The price of one offer: what it includes on the left, the price card on the right.
price_breakdown.guidance: One offer per block: on a page of several offers, such as the pricing page, one block each.

pricing_table.description: One card per package or retainer of a platform, read from the CINQ Central catalogue.
pricing_table.guidance: Do not write prices: Central is authoritative. Without Central, the section is not shown.

quote.description: One sentence of a client, then their name, role and company.
quote.guidance: Real verbatim only, never anonymous nor invented.

rich_text.description: Free text in a reading column of 720 px: headings, lists, quotes and code.

signup_form.description: Newsletter signup: title and text, then a Contact Form 7 form with the email field.
signup_form.guidance: Pick an existing Contact Form 7 form. At most one per page.

steps.description: Numbered steps of a process, each with who holds it in a badge.
